_doc: Every statement in the server tree that writes playlist_items or playlist_item_schedules, by file, with how the corporate (head office) lock covers it. test/corporate-writers-inventory.test.js fails when a count changes: classify the new writer here (spec 10 §4.7) before it can ship. JS = the guard call that gives the 403; BS = the SQLite backstop (lib/corporate/backstop.js), which fails closed inside any request whose actor cannot author.

routes/playlists.js.coverage: JS: loadPlaylistAccess(requireWrite) -> assertPlaylistWritable on every write route (items, selection, bulk, reorder, discard, duplicate, item schedules). BS.

routes/assignments.js.coverage: JS: mandated device -> add REDIRECTED into the screen's local slot content (lib/corporate/fills.js redirectTarget + assertCanAdd), never head office's playlist; reorder/copy-to refused, copy-to skips slot rows; checkItemWrite -> assertPlaylistWritable. BS.

routes/device-groups.js.coverage: JS: assign-content puts mandated members' item into the GROUP-level slot content (ensureGroupFill + assertCanAdd), never into head office's playlist. BS.

routes/schedules.js.coverage: New store playlist (auto-generated), not governed; schedules on mandated targets refused. BS.

routes/agency.js.coverage: JS: assertPlaylistWritable with the agency token actor -> CORPORATE_TOKEN; governed playlists cannot be allowlisted (lib/agency-targets.js). BS.

routes/status.js.coverage: Import / v1 conversion into NEW playlists. corporate = 1 and slot placements only when the importer is a corporate author importing into the org's HQ (spec 6.3); otherwise slots become their fallback item or are dropped. BS.

routes/corporate-slots.js.coverage: Slot placement INSERT/DELETE in a corporate playlist after requireAuthor (corporate author, never a token; JWT-only router). BS (structural trigger refuses slot_id outside a corporate playlist).

lib/corporate/fills.js.coverage: Copies flat rows into a NEW store fill playlist (createFill/copyItems), reached from the store redirects and fill routes after their access checks; fills are not governed. BS (FILL_FLAT structural trigger).

lib/slide-deck.js.coverage: Reached only from the deck routes above (JS) or as system. BS.

lib/fork-device-playlist.js.coverage: Never forks a corporate source (resolved.source === 'corporate' -> null); writes a NEW device playlist. BS.

lib/auto-playlist.js.coverage: NEW auto-generated playlists, not governed. BS.

dynamic.lib/mesh/replication.js: Generic replicated writes (table name is data). System actor on apply; corporate workspaces cannot be replicated (guard.workspaceHasCorporateState), playlist_items.slot_id is on the BLOCKLIST as a belt.
dynamic.FK cascades: content/widget delete and playlist delete cascade playlist_items: JS media protection + BS (cascades fire the TEMP triggers).
